item.title: 2 dead, 1 seriously injured in Madera County crash
item.description: Two people were killed and one person was seriously injured in a three vehicle crash over the weekend, and the driver who fled was arrested for DUI.

item.title: Artist paints over his nearly completed Cesar Chavez mural in Fresno
item.description: Artist Chaves Omar Huerta was forced to paint over his nearly finished mural after news of Cesar Chavez's sexual assault allegations surfaced, prompting the street to be renamed Cesar Chavez Boulevard.

item.title: Gas sold for 59 cents in Fresno, hacking suspected
item.description: Gas at C's Oasis Mobil in Fresno was sold for 59 cents a gallon due to hackers, resulting in a loss of money for the store.

item.title: Amber Alert deactivated for 4-year-old boy abducted by 'armed and dangerous' man
item.description: CHP issued an Amber Alert for 4-year-old Corbin Hutchins, who was abducted by 40-year-old Daniel Hutchens, who is considered armed and dangerous.

item.title: Fresno mural for Cesar Chavez painted over as allegations of sex abuse unfold
item.description: Artist Omar Huerta was forced to paint over his mural of labor rights leader Cesar Chavez after allegations of sexual abuse broke, and is now trying to decide what to replace it with in honor of the farmworker movement.

item.title: 'It's shocking': Oakhurst man suspected of secretly filming women, children in his rental property
item.description: A man in Oakhurst, California was arrested on Thursday for possession and distribution of child sexual abuse material, as well as invasion of privacy, after the Madera County Sheriff's Office found over 4,000 digital files of explicit photos and videos of children ages 5-15 on his property.

item.title: These valley cities broke their temperatures records every day - for a week
item.description: Multiple cities in California's Central Valley broke records for five consecutive days of high temperatures, with Fresno, Hanford, and Bakersfield setting new daily high records every day.

item.title: 62-year-old Corcoran man arrested for felony hit and run
item.description: Miguel Garcia, a 62-year-old man from Corcoran, was arrested for felony hit and run after allegedly hitting a man with his car and fleeing the scene on March 12th.

item.title: Fresno Police launch traffic safety for walkers, bikers
item.description: The Fresno Police Department will hold a traffic safety operation on March 28 to address dangerous driving behaviors that threaten the safety of people biking or walking.
